title.zh: 卷375 列傳一百六十二 白镕 孙桓 史致俨 那清安 升寅 李宗昉 姚元之 何汝霖 季芝昌 列傳
title.en: Volume 375 Biographies 162: Bai Rong, Sun Huan, Shi Zhiyan, Na Qingan, Sheng Yin, Li Zongfang, Yao Yuanzhi, He Rulin, Ji Zhichang, Lie Chuan
title.raw: 卷375 列傳一百六十二 白镕 孙桓 史致俨 那清安 升寅 李宗昉 姚元之 何汝霖 季芝昌 列傳

sentences.zh: 白鎔，字小山，順天通州人。

translations.literal: Bai Rong, style name Xiaoshan, was a native of Tongzhou in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Rong, styled Xiaoshan, came from Tongzhou in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，典福建鄉試。

translations.literal: In the 4th year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, was appointed compiler, and served as chief examiner for the Fujian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 he received his jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and presided over the provincial examination in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十八年，大考二等，擢贊善。

translations.literal: In the 18th year, in the major triennial evaluation he ranked second class and was promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1813, ranked second class in the triennial academy evaluation, he was promoted to tutor in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 督安徽學政，詔密詢地方利弊，疏言：「安徽錢糧，惟鳳陽、泗州遭湖、河之害，積逋較巨。

translations.literal: He served as director of education for Anhui. The emperor secretly inquired about local advantages and disadvantages. In a memorial he stated: "As for land tax and grain tribute in Anhui, only Fengyang and Sizhou, having suffered harm from lakes and rivers, have relatively large accumulated arrears.
translations.idiomatic: As educational commissioner for Anhui, he received an imperial order to report confidentially on local conditions. In a memorial he wrote: "Among Anhui's land tax and grain levies, Fengyang and Sizhou alone suffer from flooding by lakes and rivers, and their accumulated arrears are exceptionally large.

sentences.zh: 遇豐稔之年，循例帶徵舊額。

translations.literal: In years of good harvest, according to precedent they levied the old quotas along with current taxes.
translations.idiomatic: In good harvest years the usual practice was to collect current levies together with past arrears at the old rates.

sentences.zh: 在小民以一年而輸數年之賦，雖樂歲不免拮据；

translations.literal: For common people this meant paying several years' taxes in one year; even in a prosperous year they could not avoid hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners had to pay several years' worth of taxes in a single year, and even in bountiful seasons they still struggled to make ends meet.

sentences.zh: 而官吏懼譴，規避多方，積重難返。

translations.literal: Meanwhile officials feared reprimand and sought many ways to evade responsibility, so the accumulated burden became hard to reverse.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, fearing censure, dodged responsibility by every means, and the arrears grew so heavy they could not be recovered.

sentences.zh: 與其存徵之名，緻小民日受追呼，國計依然無補，何如核徵之實，使官吏從容措理，舊額尚可漸清。

translations.literal: Rather than keeping the name of collection in place and letting common people suffer daily dunning while state revenue remained unhelped, how much better to verify actual collections, let officials handle matters at ease, and gradually clear the old quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Keeping collections on the books only meant commoners faced daily harassment while state revenue gained nothing. Better to collect what could actually be recovered, let officials work at a manageable pace, and gradually clear the backlog.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後二屬錢糧，每年祗帶徵一年，儻遇歉收，再行遞緩，民力漸紓，催科者自顧考成，行之必有效。」

translations.literal: He requested that henceforth for the two jurisdictions' land tax and grain, each year only one year of arrears be collected along with current tax; if there were poor harvests, further deferral should be granted; common people's strength would gradually be relieved; tax collectors would themselves regard their performance evaluation; implementing this would surely be effective."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that for these two districts only one year of arrears be added to the annual levy; in years of poor harvest further deferrals could be granted. This would ease the burden on the people, give tax collectors incentive to meet their quotas, and would prove effective in practice."

sentences.zh: 詔允行。

translations.literal: The imperial decree approved implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 青陽有孝子曰徐守仁，幼孤，事母孝。

translations.literal: In Qingyang there was a filial son named Xu Shouren; orphaned at a young age, he was filial in serving his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingyang lived a filial son named Xu Shouren, who lost his father early and devoted himself to caring for his mother.

sentences.zh: 母沒，廬墓三年，鎔造廬贈賻，題請旌表。

translations.literal: When his mother died, he lived by the tomb in a hut for three years. Bai Rong built a hut and gave funeral gifts, and submitted a petition for an official commendation.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's death Xu observed three years of mourning in a hut at her grave. Bai Rong built the hut, sent gifts of condolence, and recommended him for official recognition.

sentences.zh: 訪求明臣左光斗遺裔，取列縣庠。

translations.literal: He searched for descendants of the Ming minister Zuo Guangdou and enrolled them in the county school.
translations.idiomatic: He sought out descendants of the Ming loyalist Zuo Guangdou and enrolled them in the local schools.

sentences.zh: 按試所至，集士人講學，以正人心厚風俗為本。

translations.literal: Wherever he went for examination tours, he gathered scholars to lecture on learning, taking rectification of people's hearts and thickening of customs as the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever his inspection tours took him, he gathered scholars for lectures, making moral cultivation and sound local customs his guiding principle.

sentences.zh: 累遷少詹事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to junior tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to junior tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，督廣東學政。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Daoguang, he served as director of education for Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1821 he became educational commissioner for Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 歷詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served as tutor and as Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of tutor to the heir apparent and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢工部侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, he was promoted to vice minister of the Ministry of Works and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In 1827 he was promoted to vice minister of Works and transferred to Personnel.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕尚書松筠赴直隸按外委白勤被誣冤斃獄，護理總督屠之申以下降黜有差。

translations.literal: In the 9th year, together with Minister Songyun he went to Zhili to investigate the case of the low-ranking official Bai Qin, who had been falsely accused and wrongfully died in prison; acting governor-general Tu Zhisen and others were demoted with varying severity.
translations.idiomatic: In 1829 he joined Minister Songyun in Zhili to investigate the wrongful imprisonment and death of the petty official Bai Qin. Acting governor-general Tu Zhisen and subordinates received demotions of varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He served as director of education for Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner for Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 尋偕侍郎寶興勘視南河垛料，舉實以聞。

translations.literal: Soon after, together with Vice Minister Baoxing he inspected the grain stockpiles of the Southern Grand Canal and reported the actual conditions to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Vice Minister Baoxing to inspect grain stockpiles along the Southern Grand Canal and reported what they found.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢左都御史，召還京，未至，命查勘江南災賑。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, he was promoted to left censor-in-chief and recalled to the capital; before arriving, he was ordered to inspect disaster relief in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1831 he was promoted to left censor-in-chief and recalled to Beijing, but before reaching the capital was dispatched to inspect disaster relief in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 時尚書穆彰阿、硃士彥亦奉命勘湖、河汎溢狀，穆彰阿先回京，鎔遂偕士彥履勘沿河閘壩工程，與總督陶澍定議以工代賑。

translations.literal: At the time Ministers Mujiang'a and Zhu Shiyan were also ordered to inspect flood conditions of lakes and rivers. Mujiang'a returned to the capital first; Bai Rong then together with Shiyan personally inspected sluice and dam projects along the river, and with Governor-General Tao Shu decided on work-for-relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers Mujiang'a and Zhu Shiyan had also been sent to assess flooding on lakes and rivers. Mujiang'a returned first, whereupon Bai Rong and Zhu Shiyan inspected sluice and dam projects along the waterways and, with Governor-General Tao Shu, adopted relief work in place of direct grain distribution.

sentences.zh: 赴安徽，週曆太平、寧國、池州、安慶、廬州各郡，先後疏劾飾災侵賑諸弊。

translations.literal: He went to Anhui and toured the prefectures of Taiping, Ningguo, Chizhou, Anqing, and Luzhou, sequentially memorializing and impeaching various abuses of fabricating disasters and embezzling relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Anhui he toured Taiping, Ningguo, Chizhou, Anqing, and Luzhou, submitting successive memorials impeaching officials for falsifying disaster reports and embezzling relief funds.

sentences.zh: 次年，回京，署翰林院掌院學士，典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: The following year he returned to the capital, served as acting chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to Beijing, served as acting chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and presided over the metropolitan provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢工部尚書，典武會試。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, he was promoted to minister of the Ministry of Works and presided over the military metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In 1833 he was promoted to minister of Works and presided over the military metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 故事，武闈雙好不足額，始取單好。

translations.literal: According to precedent, in the military examination if those excelling in both archery and mounted archery did not fill the quota, only then were those excelling in one taken.
translations.idiomatic: By established rule, when candidates excelling in both archery and mounted archery failed to fill the quota, candidates with a single excellence were admitted.

sentences.zh: 是科雙好不盡取中，坐降大理寺卿。

translations.literal: In this session not all dual-excellence candidates were fully passed; for this he was demoted to chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: That year not all dual-excellence candidates were passed, and for this Bai Rong was demoted to chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 十九年，乞病歸，卒於家，年七十四。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home; he died at home, aged seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: In 1839 he resigned on grounds of illness and returned home, where he died at the age of seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 鎔事母孝，教子弟嚴。

translations.literal: Bai Rong was filial in serving his mother and strict in teaching his sons and nephews.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Rong was devoted to his mother and strict in the upbringing of his children and nephews.

sentences.zh: 宣宗嘗嘉其家法之善，以勉朝臣雲。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor once praised the goodness of his household discipline, using it to encourage court officials and so on.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanzong Emperor once praised his household discipline as a model for encouraging other court officials.

sentences.zh: 孫桓，字建侯。

translations.literal: Sun Huan, style name Jianhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Huan, styled Jianhou.

sentences.zh: 同治二年進士，授吏部主事。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Tongzhi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a principal clerk of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he received his jinshi degree and was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to department director.

sentences.zh: 掌選，清嚴慎密，吏不能欺，為時所稱。

translations.literal: In charge of selections, he was pure, strict, and cautious; clerks could not deceive him; he was praised by his contemporaries.
translations.idiomatic: As head of personnel selection he was rigorous and scrupulous, leaving no opening for clerks to manipulate the process, and won widespread esteem.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，洊擢兵部侍郎，綜覈一如為司官時。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu reign he was repeatedly promoted to vice minister of the Ministry of War; his comprehensive review was just as when he was a department officer.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu reign he was promoted to vice minister of War, handling reviews with the same thoroughness he had shown as a clerk.

sentences.zh: 十七年，因病乞休，尋卒。

translations.literal: In the 17th year, he requested retirement due to illness; soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1891 he retired on grounds of illness and died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 史致儼，字容莊，江蘇江都人。

translations.literal: Shi Zhiyan, style name Rongzhuang, was a native of Jiangdu in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiyan, styled Rongzhuang, came from Jiangdu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 家酷貧。

translations.literal: His family was extremely poor.
translations.idiomatic: His family was desperately poor.

sentences.zh: 甫冠，為諸生，學政謝墉器其才，給膏火，居尊經閣讀書。

translations.literal: Having just reached manhood, he became a student; educational commissioner Xie Yong admired his talent, provided stipend, and let him live in the Zunjing Pavilion to study.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after coming of age he enrolled as a student. Educational Commissioner Xie Yong recognized his ability, provided him a stipend, and allowed him to study in the Zunjing Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 薦預召試，未與選。

translations.literal: He was recommended for a special imperial examination but was not selected.
translations.idiomatic: He was recommended for a special palace examination but was not chosen.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the 4th year of Jiaqing, he became a jinshi; was selected as Hanlin bachelor; was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 he received his jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 督四川學政。

translations.literal: He served as director of education for Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner for Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 累遷右庶子。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to right vice tutor of the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to right vice tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，督河南學政。

translations.literal: In the 21st year, he served as director of education for Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1816 he became educational commissioner for Henan.

sentences.zh: 自滑縣匪平，猶有伏莽，密詔偵察。

translations.literal: Since the bandits in Huaxian had been suppressed, hidden outlaws still remained, and he received a secret order to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Although the bandits in Huaxian had been put down, hidden outlaws still remained, and he received a secret order to investigate.

sentences.zh: 疏陳彰、衛二郡民間習邪教猶眾，州縣編查保甲，有名無實，撰敦俗篇，刊布以化導之。

translations.literal: He memorialized that in Zhang and Wei prefectures heretical sects were still widespread among the people, that county officials nominally organized the baojia system but it existed in name only, and he compiled an essay on cultivating customs to publish and guide reform.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that heretical sects remained widespread in Zhang and Wei prefectures, that county officials maintained the baojia system in name only, and he compiled and published an essay on cultivating customs to guide reform.

sentences.zh: 商丘廩生陳忠錦以不濫保被毆，知府、經歷受賕，反加斥責，忿而自經。

translations.literal: Chen Zhongjin, a government stipend student of Shangqiu, was beaten for refusing to give false guarantees; the prefect and assistant received bribes and instead rebuked him, and in anger he hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhongjin, a government stipend student in Shangqiu, was beaten for refusing to give false guarantees. The prefect and his assistant took bribes and rebuked him instead; in anger he hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 疏劾，譴罪有差。

translations.literal: He memorialized an impeachment, and punishments were meted out according to degree of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted an impeachment memorial, and the guilty parties received punishments of varying severity.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，典湖北鄉試。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Daoguang, he presided over the provincial examination in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In 1821 he presided over the provincial examination in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢刑部侍郎，調禮部。

translations.literal: In the 3rd year, he was promoted to vice minister of the Ministry of Punishments and transferred to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In 1823 he was promoted to vice minister of Justice and transferred to Rites.

sentences.zh: 五年，督福建學政。

translations.literal: In the 5th year, he served as director of education for Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In 1825 he became educational commissioner for Fujian.

sentences.zh: 奏分台灣舉人中額，增所屬四縣學額。

translations.literal: He memorialized to allocate Taiwan's quota of successful provincial candidates separately and increase the school quotas for four subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to set aside a separate quota of juren for Taiwan and increase the school enrollment quotas for four subordinate counties.

sentences.zh: 漳、泉諸郡習械鬥，諸生與者，屏不與試，悍風稍息。

translations.literal: In Zhang and Quan prefectures armed feuding was common; students who participated were barred from examinations, and the violent customs gradually subsided.
translations.idiomatic: Armed feuding was common in Zhang and Quan prefectures; students who took part were barred from examinations, and the violent customs gradually subsided.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕侍郎鍾昌赴山西鞫獄，平定知州故出人罪，鞫實，論兇犯如律，褫知州恆傑職。

translations.literal: In the 9th year, together with Vice Minister Zhong Chang he went to Shanxi to try a case where the prefect of Pingding had improperly released criminals; the facts were established, the assailants were sentenced according to law, and Prefect Heng Jie was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1829 he joined Vice Minister Zhong Chang in Shanxi to try a case in which the prefect of Pingding had improperly released criminals. The facts were established, the assailants were sentenced according to law, and Prefect Heng Jie was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 調刑部，歷左都御史，遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, served as left censor-in-chief, and was promoted to minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred to Justice, served as left censor-in-chief, and was promoted to minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 兩典順天鄉試。

translations.literal: He twice presided over the Shuntian provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He twice presided over the metropolitan provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 調工部，又調刑部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Works and then again to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Works and then back to Justice.

sentences.zh: 勤於其職，竟日坐堂上閱案牘，揅析論難，視司員如弟子。

translations.literal: Diligent in his duties, he sat all day in court reviewing case documents, analyzing and debating them, treating his subordinates like disciples.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in his duties, he sat in court all day reviewing case documents, analyzing and debating them, and treated his subordinates like disciples.

sentences.zh: 任刑部凡四年，京察，以刑名詳慎，被議敘。

translations.literal: He served in the Ministry of Punishments for four years in all; at the metropolitan performance review he was commended for thoroughness and caution in legal matters.
translations.idiomatic: After four years in the Ministry of Justice, he received a favorable rating at the metropolitan performance review for thoroughness and caution in legal matters.

sentences.zh: 十八年，乞解職。

translations.literal: In the 18th year, he requested to resign from office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1838 he requested to resign.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年七十九，贈太子太保，祀鄉賢及名宦祠。

translations.literal: Soon after he died, aged seventy-nine; posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; enshrined in local worthy and eminent official temples.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after at the age of seventy-nine. He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and enshrined in local temples of worthy men and eminent officials.

sentences.zh: 那清安，字竹汀，葉赫納喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Na Qingan, style name Zhuting, of the Yehenara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qingan, styled Zhuting, of the Yehenara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，授戶部主事，遷翰林院侍講。

translations.literal: In the 10th year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a principal clerk of the Ministry of Revenue, and was transferred to Hanlin lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1805 he received his jinshi degree, was appointed a principal clerk in the Board of Revenue, and was transferred to Hanlin lecturer.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授禮部侍郎，歷刑部、工部。

translations.literal: In the 24th year, he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Rites and later served in the Ministries of Punishments and Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1819 he was appointed vice minister of Rites, later serving in Justice and Works.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，命赴直隸讞獄，擢左都御史，管光祿寺事，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Daoguang, he was ordered to go to Zhili to review criminal cases; was promoted to left censor-in-chief; put in charge of the Imperial Household Department of Delicacies; and concurrently served as banner general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1821 he was dispatched to Zhili to review criminal cases, promoted to left censor-in-chief, put in charge of the Imperial Household Department of Delicacies, and concurrently served as banner general.

sentences.zh: 尋遷兵部尚書，調刑部。

translations.literal: Soon after he was promoted to minister of the Ministry of War and transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was promoted to minister of War and transferred to Justice.

sentences.zh: 四年，出為熱河都統，偕左都御史松筠等赴土默特讞獄，事竣，疏言：「蒙古惡習，常有移屍訛詐，為害滋甚。

translations.literal: In the 4th year, he went out as commander of Rehe, together with Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun and others went to Tumed to review criminal cases, and upon completion memorialized: "Among Mongol bad customs, moving corpses for extortion is common and the harm is increasingly severe.
translations.idiomatic: In 1824 he went out as commander of Rehe and, together with Left Censor-in-Chief Songyun and others, reviewed criminal cases in Tumed. Upon completion he memorialized: "Among Mongol bad customs, moving corpses to extort money is common and the harm is increasingly severe.

sentences.zh: 蒙古律例，凡軍流徒犯，罪止折枷，情重法輕。

translations.literal: Under the Mongol legal code, for all offenders subject to military exile, banishment, or penal servitude, punishment was limited to commuted cangue; the crime was serious but the penalty light.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Mongol legal code, offenders subject to military exile, banishment, or penal servitude received only commuted cangue punishment—the crime was serious but the penalty light.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後遇有假捏人命詐財者，所擬軍流徒罪即行實發，不准折枷，以懲刁惡。」

translations.literal: He requested that henceforth when there were those who fabricated deaths to extort money, the proposed sentences of military exile, banishment, or penal servitude be immediately carried out in full, without commutation to the cangue, to punish the cunning and wicked."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that henceforth those who fabricated deaths to extort money serve their full sentences of exile or penal servitude without commutation to the cangue, to punish the cunning and wicked."

sentences.zh: 下所司議行。

translations.literal: The memorial was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 六年，召授左都御史。

translations.literal: In the 6th year, he was recalled and appointed left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1826 he was recalled and appointed left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 逾年，復任熱河都統，召對，詢知其母年老，命仍還左都御史任。

translations.literal: The following year he again served as commander of Rehe; summoned for audience, the emperor inquired and learned his mother was elderly, and ordered him to return to his post as left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he again served as commander of Rehe. Summoned for audience, the emperor learned his mother was elderly and ordered him to return to his post as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一年，复授兵部尚書，典順天鄉試及會試。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, he was again appointed minister of the Ministry of War and presided over the Shuntian provincial and metropolitan examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In 1831 he was again appointed minister of War and presided over the metropolitan provincial and metropolitan examinations.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以疾乞解職，允之。

translations.literal: In the 14th year, he requested to resign due to illness and was granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1834 he requested to resign due to illness and was granted permission.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太保，諡恭勤。

translations.literal: Soon after he died; posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; posthumous name Gongqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after. He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Gongqin (Respectful and Diligent).

sentences.zh: 那清安工為館體應制詩，時皆誦習。

translations.literal: Na Qingan excelled at composing regulated verse for imperial occasions; at the time all recited and studied them.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qingan excelled at composing regulated verse for imperial occasions, and his poems were widely recited.

sentences.zh: 因與穆彰阿同榜成進士，晚乃受宣宗知，迭秉文衡。

translations.literal: Because he passed the jinshi examination in the same year as Mujiang'a, only late in life did he win the Xuanzong Emperor's favor and repeatedly hold examination offices.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the jinshi examination in the same year as Mujiang'a, he won the Xuanzong Emperor's favor only late in life and repeatedly held examination offices.

sentences.zh: 既卒，會兵部以慶廉送武會試有殘疾，為監試御史所劾。

translations.literal: After his death, it happened that the Ministry of War sent Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite his physical disability, and he was impeached by the supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: After his death, the Ministry of War sent Qing Lian to the military metropolitan examination despite his physical disability, and he was impeached by the supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 先是那清安為監射大臣，曾以慶廉殘疾扣除，上追念其持正，予其子全慶加二級。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Na Qingan had served as supervising archery officer, he had disqualified Qing Lian for disability; the emperor recalled his uprightness and granted his son Quanqing a two-grade promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Na Qingan had served as supervising archery officer, he had disqualified Qing Lian for disability. The emperor recalled his integrity and granted his son Quanqing a two-grade promotion.

sentences.zh: 全慶，光緒初官大學士，自有傳。

translations.literal: Quanqing, in the early Guangxu reign served as grand secretary; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Quanqing became a grand secretary in the early Guangxu reign and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 昇寅，字賓旭，馬佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sheng Yin, style name Binxu, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yin, styled Binxu, of the Majia clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授禮部七品小京官。

translations.literal: Selected as tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 舉嘉慶五年鄉試。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination in the 5th year of Jiaqing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in 1800.

sentences.zh: 累遷員外郎，改御史。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to department vice director and was transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to department vice director and was transferred to censor.

sentences.zh: 疏言學校為人才根本，請嚴課程，務實用，戒奢靡；

translations.literal: He memorialized that schools were the foundation of talent and requested strict curricula, practical utility, and curbing of extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that schools were the foundation of talent and requested strict curricula emphasizing practical utility and curbing extravagance.

sentences.zh: 又疏陳防禁考試八旗生懷挾冒替諸弊：從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized on preventing cheating, impersonation, and smuggling of notes among banner students in examinations: the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized on preventing cheating, impersonation, and smuggling of notes among banner students in examinations, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 改右庶子，累遷副都御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to right vice tutor of the heir apparent and was repeatedly promoted to vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to right vice tutor of the heir apparent, he rose to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授盛京禮部侍郎，署盛京將軍。

translations.literal: In the 21st year, he was appointed vice minister of Rites at Mukden and served as acting general of Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In 1816 he was appointed vice minister of Rites at Mukden and served as acting general of Mukden.

sentences.zh: 調刑部，召為工部侍郎，又調刑部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, recalled as vice minister of the Ministry of Works, and again transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred to Justice, was recalled as vice minister of Works, and then transferred back to Justice.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: In the 6th year of Daoguang, he went out as commander of Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In 1826 he went out as commander of Rehe.

sentences.zh: 以蒙古各旗招內地遊民開採煤礦，往往生事械鬥，疏請諭禁，從之。

translations.literal: Because Mongol banners recruited inland migrants to mine coal, often provoking violence and armed feuds, he memorialized requesting a prohibition, which was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mongol banners recruited inland migrants to mine coal, often provoking violence and armed feuds, he memorialized requesting a prohibition, which was approved.

sentences.zh: 八年，命赴甘肅偕總督鄂山按寧夏將軍慶山、副都統噶普唐阿互劾事，罷慶山，即以昇寅代之。

translations.literal: In the 8th year, he was ordered to go to Gansu together with Governor-General Eshan to investigate mutual impeachments between Ningxia General Qingshan and Vice Banner General Gaputang'a; Qingshan was dismissed and Sheng Yin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1828 he was sent to Gansu with Governor-General Eshan to investigate mutual impeachments between Ningxia General Qingshan and Vice Banner General Gaputang'a. Qingshan was dismissed and Sheng Yin replaced him.

sentences.zh: 歷成都、綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: He served as general at Chengdu and at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as general at Chengdu and at Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 命鞫鄂爾多斯京控獄，奏言：「蒙古京控日繁，請自後各部落封禁地樹立界牌，以杜私墾；

translations.literal: Ordered to try an appeal case from Ordos at Beijing, he memorialized: "Appeals to the capital from Mongolia grow daily; hereafter boundary markers should be erected on sealed tribal lands of each league to prevent illegal cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to try an appeal case from Ordos at Beijing, he memorialized: "Appeals to the capital from Mongolia grow daily. Hereafter boundary markers should be erected on sealed tribal lands of each league to prevent illegal cultivation.

sentences.zh: 蒙古阿勒巴圖禁止餽贈，以息爭端；

translations.literal: Mongol common soldiers should be forbidden to give gifts, to settle disputes.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts among Mongol common soldiers should be prohibited to settle disputes.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克王、貝勒等毋用內地書吏，以免教唆；

translations.literal: League princes, beile, and others should not employ inland clerks, to avoid instigation.
translations.idiomatic: League princes, beile, and others should not employ inland clerks, to avoid instigation.

sentences.zh: 各旗協理台吉，會同盟長選舉，以昭慎重；

translations.literal: Assistant princes for each banner should be jointly elected by league chiefs, to show careful deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant princes for each banner should be jointly elected by league chiefs to ensure careful selection.

sentences.zh: 盟長會盟需用烏拉，應明定限制，以免浮索：庶積弊清而獄訟息。」

translations.literal: For league chiefs' assemblies, ula are required; limits should be clearly set to avoid excessive demands: thus accumulated abuses may be cleared and lawsuits cease."
translations.idiomatic: The ula required for league chiefs' assemblies should have clearly defined limits to avoid exorbitant demands, so that accumulated abuses could be cleared and lawsuits cease."

sentences.zh: 十一年，召授左都御史，兼都統。

translations.literal: In the 11th year, he was recalled and appointed left censor-in-chief, concurrently serving as banner general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1831 he was recalled and appointed left censor-in-chief, concurrently serving as banner general.

sentences.zh: 十二年，署工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the 12th year, he served as acting minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1832 he served as acting minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 京畿旱，疏請發米，設十廠煮粥以濟災民，從之。

translations.literal: The capital region suffered drought; he memorialized requesting grain distribution and the establishment of ten soup kitchens to aid disaster victims; the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: When drought struck the capital region, he memorialized requesting grain distribution and ten soup kitchens to aid disaster victims, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕侍郎鄂順安按西安將軍徐錕貪縱，得實，議褫職。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, together with Vice Minister Eshun'an he investigated Xi'an General Xu Kun for corruption and indulgence; the facts were established and dismissal was recommended.
translations.idiomatic: In 1833 he joined Vice Minister Eshun'an to investigate Xi'an General Xu Kun for corruption and indulgence. The facts were established and dismissal was recommended.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命閱兵山東、河南，就鞫桐柏知縣寧飛濱故出人罪，治如律。

translations.literal: In the 14th year, he was ordered to review troops in Shandong and Henan; en route he tried the case of Tongbai magistrate Ning Feibin, who had improperly released criminals, and punished him according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In 1834 he was ordered to review troops in Shandong and Henan and, en route, tried the case of Tongbai magistrate Ning Feibin, who had improperly released criminals, sentencing him according to law.

sentences.zh: 命赴廣東、湖南按事，授禮部尚書，未至，卒於途。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Guangdong and Hunan to investigate affairs; was appointed minister of the Ministry of Rites; before arriving, he died en route.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to investigate affairs in Guangdong and Hunan and was appointed minister of Rites, but died en route before reaching his destination.

sentences.zh: 優詔賜卹，稱其老成清介，贈太子太保，諡勤直。

translations.literal: An imperial favor granted relief; he was praised for maturity and integrity; posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; posthumous name Qinzhí.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted special relief and praised his maturity and integrity. He was posthumously granted the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Qinzhí (Diligent and Upright).

sentences.zh: 子寶琳，直隸保定知府，濬定州洿澤，有治績；

translations.literal: His son Baolin served as prefect of Baoding in Zhili; dredged the marshes of Dingzhou and had administrative achievements.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baolin served as prefect of Baoding in Zhili, dredged the marshes of Dingzhou, and achieved notable administrative results.

sentences.zh: 寶珣，同治中，官兵部侍郎、山海關副都統。

translations.literal: Baoxun, during the Tongzhi reign, served as vice minister of the Ministry of War and vice banner general at Shanhaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxun, during the Tongzhi reign, served as vice minister of War and vice banner general at Shanhaiguan.

sentences.zh: 孫紹祺，咸豐六年進士，由編修官至理籓院尚書；

translations.literal: His grandson Shaoqi, a jinshi of the 6th year of Xianfeng, rose from compiler to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Shaoqi, a jinshi of 1856, rose from compiler to minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 紹諴，光緒中，山西布政使，從治鄭州河工，終駐藏大臣；

translations.literal: Shaoxian, during the Guangxu reign, served as financial commissioner of Shanxi, assisted in managing the Zhengzhou river works, and ended as resident minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoxian, during the Guangxu reign, served as financial commissioner of Shanxi, assisted in managing the Zhengzhou river works, and ended his career as resident minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 紹英，宣統初，度支部侍郎，內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Shaoying, in the early Xuantong reign, served as vice minister of the Board of Revenue and minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoying, in the early Xuantong reign, served as vice minister of the Board of Revenue and minister of the Imperial Household.

sentences.zh: 李宗昉，字芝齡，江蘇山陽人。

translations.literal: Li Zongfang, style name Zhiling, was a native of Shanyang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongfang, styled Zhiling, came from Shanyang in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年一甲二名進士，授編修，典陝甘鄉試。

translations.literal: In the 7th year of Jiaqing he ranked second among the top three jinshi graduates, was appointed compiler, and presided over the provincial examination in Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1802 he ranked second among the top three jinshi graduates, was appointed compiler, and presided over the provincial examination in Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 大考二等，擢贊善。

translations.literal: In the major triennial evaluation he ranked second class and was promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Ranked second class in the triennial academy evaluation, he was promoted to tutor in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 督貴州學政，累遷侍讀學士，督浙江學政。

translations.literal: He served as director of education for Guizhou, was repeatedly promoted to reader of the Hanlin Academy, and served as director of education for Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner for Guizhou, rose to reader of the Hanlin Academy, and became educational commissioner for Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 歷詹事、內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served as tutor and as Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of tutor to the heir apparent and Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Daoguang, he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In 1821 he was appointed vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 次年，典會試，又典江西鄉試，留學政。

translations.literal: The following year he presided over the metropolitan examination, then presided over the provincial examination in Jiangxi and remained as educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he presided over the metropolitan examination, then the provincial examination in Jiangxi, and remained as educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 值大水，歲饑，與巡撫籌賑務，多所全活。

translations.literal: When great floods struck and famine followed, he together with the governor-general organized relief work and saved many lives.
translations.idiomatic: When severe flooding and famine struck, he worked with the governor-general to organize relief and saved many lives.

sentences.zh: 調戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 初，宗昉督學貴州時，巡撫議丈全省田為增賦計，民情惶駭，會檄學官徵集圖書，得御史包承祚奏疏，乾隆初，學政鄒一桂請丈田，而承祚奏駁之，極言黔中山多平地少，民每虛佔不毛之地，胥吏高下其手，以丈高下不可準之田，賦未必增，民受其害。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zongfang served as educational commissioner in Guizhou, the governor-general proposed surveying all land in the province to increase taxation; the people were terrified. By chance an order was sent to educational officials to collect documents, and he obtained a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo. In the early Qianlong reign, educational commissioner Zou Yigui had requested land surveys, but Chengzuo memorialized in rebuttal, stating emphatically that in Guizhou mountains were many and flat land few, that people often falsely claimed barren land, that clerks manipulated matters, that surveying land of uneven quality would not necessarily increase revenue, and that the people would suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zongfang was educational commissioner in Guizhou, the governor-general proposed surveying all land in the province to increase taxation, terrifying the populace. When educational officials were ordered to collect documents, he found a memorial by Censor Bao Chengzuo. In the early Qianlong reign, Educational Commissioner Zou Yigui had requested land surveys, but Chengzuo had memorialized in rebuttal, arguing that Guizhou had more mountains than flat land, that people often falsely claimed barren plots, that clerks manipulated the process, that surveying uneven terrain would not necessarily increase revenue, and that the people would suffer.

sentences.zh: 部議停止，宗昉持以示巡撫曰：「此事學臣嘗奏之，被駁。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and halted the plan. Zongfang took the document and showed it to the governor-general, saying: "This matter was once memorialized by an educational commissioner and was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and halted the plan. Zongfang showed the document to the governor-general and said: "An educational commissioner once memorialized on this matter and was rejected.

sentences.zh: 今必解其所駁乃可。」

translations.literal: Now you must resolve the grounds of that rejection before proceeding."
translations.idiomatic: You must resolve the grounds of that rejection before proceeding."

sentences.zh: 巡撫亦悟，事得寢。

translations.literal: The governor-general also understood, and the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general understood as well, and the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 至是，官戶部，署巡撫麟慶因復奏上其事，部援故事詳覆之，乃定議不行。

translations.literal: At this time, serving in the Ministry of Revenue, acting governor-general Lin Qing again memorialized on the matter; the ministry cited precedent in detailed reply, and the decision was made not to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: By then serving in the Ministry of Revenue, he found that acting governor-general Lin Qing had again memorialized on the matter. The ministry cited precedent in a detailed reply, and the proposal was finally rejected.

sentences.zh: 歷工部、吏部侍郎，兼管國子監、順天府尹事。

translations.literal: He served as vice minister of the Ministries of Works and Personnel, concurrently managing the Imperial Academy and the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice minister of Works and Personnel, concurrently managing the Imperial Academy and the Shuntian prefect.

sentences.zh: 自七年至十年，典順天鄉試二，會試一，浙江鄉試一，得士稱盛。

translations.literal: From the 7th to the 10th year, he presided over two Shuntian provincial examinations, one metropolitan examination, and one Zhejiang provincial examination; the scholars he selected were acclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: From 1827 to 1830 he presided over two metropolitan provincial examinations, one metropolitan examination, and one Zhejiang provincial examination, selecting scholars widely acclaimed for their talent.

sentences.zh: 擢左都御史、禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to left censor-in-chief and minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to left censor-in-chief and minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，以疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the 24th year, he requested retirement due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: In 1844 he retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，依例賜卹。

translations.literal: In the 26th year, he died; relief was granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1846 he died, and relief was granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 姚元之，字伯昂，安徽桐城人。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi, style name Bo'ang, was a native of Tongcheng in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi, styled Bo'ang, came from Tongcheng in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，典陝甘鄉試。

translations.literal: In the 10th year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, was appointed compiler, and presided over the provincial examination in Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1805 he received his jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy, was appointed compiler, and presided over the provincial examination in Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 入直南書房。

translations.literal: He entered service in the Southern Library.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service in the Southern Library.

sentences.zh: 給事中花傑劾戴衢亨、英和援引，詔元之文字本佳，斥傑詆訐，尋亦罷元之入直。

translations.literal: Censor Hua Jie impeached Dai Quheng and Yinghe for patronage. An imperial decree stated that Yuanzhi's writing was originally excellent, rebuked Jie for slander, but soon also dismissed Yuanzhi from Southern Library service.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hua Jie impeached Dai Quheng and Yinghe for patronage. The emperor declared that Yuanzhi's writing was excellent and rebuked Jie for slander, but soon dismissed Yuanzhi from Southern Library service as well.

sentences.zh: 十七年，大考一等，擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the 17th year, in the major triennial evaluation he ranked first class and was promoted to lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1812, ranked first class in the triennial academy evaluation, he was promoted to Hanlin lecturer.

sentences.zh: 復以武英殿刊刻聖訓有誤，仍降編修。

translations.literal: Again, because the Wuying Hall edition of the Sacred Instructions contained errors, he was again demoted to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He was again demoted to compiler because the Wuying Hall edition of the Sacred Instructions contained errors.

sentences.zh: 十九年，督河南學政，疏禁坊刻類典等書以杜剿襲；

translations.literal: In the 19th year, he served as director of education for Henan and memorialized prohibiting commercially printed reference books to prevent plagiarism.
translations.idiomatic: In 1814, as educational commissioner for Henan, he memorialized prohibiting commercially printed reference books to prevent plagiarism.

sentences.zh: 又密陳河南與安徽、湖北交界地多捻匪，陳州、汝寧鹽運迥殊，土匪把持：並嘉納之。

translations.literal: He also confidentially reported that the borderlands of Henan with Anhui and Hubei had many Nian bandits, that salt transport in Chenzhou and Runing differed greatly, and that local bandits controlled the trade: all were commended and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: He also confidentially reported that Nian bandits were numerous in the borderlands where Henan met Anhui and Hubei, that salt transport in Chenzhou and Runing differed greatly, and that local bandits controlled the trade. The emperor commended and accepted all these reports.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 道光十三年，授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the 13th year of Daoguang, he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1833 he was appointed vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 疏陳台灣營務積弊，窩娼聚賭，械鬥殺人，操演僱人替代，詔下閩督嚴察整頓。

translations.literal: He memorialized on accumulated abuses in Taiwan garrison affairs: harboring prostitutes, gathering for gambling, armed feuds and killings, and hiring substitutes for drill practice; an imperial decree ordered the Fujian governor-general to strictly investigate and rectify.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on accumulated abuses in Taiwan garrison affairs—harboring prostitutes, gambling, armed feuds and killings, and hiring substitutes for drill practice. The emperor ordered the Fujian governor-general to strictly investigate and rectify the situation.

sentences.zh: 調戶部，又調刑部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and then again to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Revenue and then to Justice.

sentences.zh: 迭典順天、江西鄉試。

translations.literal: He successively presided over the provincial examinations in Shuntian and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He successively presided over the provincial examinations in Shuntian and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 督浙江學政，未滿，十八年，擢左都御史，召回京。

translations.literal: He served as director of education for Zhejiang; before completing his term, in the 18th year he was promoted to left censor-in-chief and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: As educational commissioner for Zhejiang, before completing his term, in 1838 he was promoted to left censor-in-chief and recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 尋以南昌知府張寅為江西巡撫裕泰劾罷，元之為寅疏辯，臚陳政績，請查辦，詔斥冒昧，降二級調用。

translations.literal: Soon after, Nanchang prefect Zhang Yin was impeached and dismissed by Jiangxi governor-general Yu Tai; Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, enumerating his achievements and requesting investigation; an imperial decree rebuked him for presumption and demoted him two grades for reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, Jiangxi Governor-General Yu Tai impeached and dismissed Nanchang Prefect Zhang Yin. Yuanzhi memorialized in Zhang's defense, enumerating his achievements and requesting an investigation. The emperor rebuked him for presumption and demoted him two grades for reassignment.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，海防方亟，疏陳廣東形勢，豫籌戰守，下靖逆將軍奕山等採行。

translations.literal: In the 21st year, coastal defense was urgent; he memorialized on Guangdong's strategic situation and planned for offense and defense in advance; the memorial was sent down to General Yishan and others for adoption.
translations.idiomatic: In 1841, with coastal defense urgent, he memorialized on Guangdong's strategic situation and proposed advance plans for offense and defense. The memorial was sent to General Yishan and others for implementation.

sentences.zh: 授內閣學士。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，京察，以年衰休致。

translations.literal: In the 23rd year, at the metropolitan performance review, he retired due to advanced age.
translations.idiomatic: In 1843, at the metropolitan performance review, he retired due to advanced age.

sentences.zh: 元之學於族祖鼐，文章爾雅，書畫並工。

translations.literal: Yuanzhi studied under his clan elder Nai; his essays were refined and elegant, and he was skilled in both calligraphy and painting.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanzhi studied under his clan elder Nai. His essays were refined and elegant, and he was skilled in both calligraphy and painting.

sentences.zh: 習於掌故，館閣推為祭酒。

translations.literal: Well versed in institutional precedents, he was acclaimed in the Hanlin as its leading authority.
translations.idiomatic: Well versed in institutional precedents, he was acclaimed in the Hanlin as its leading authority.

sentences.zh: 愛士好事，穆彰阿素重之。

translations.literal: He loved scholars and enjoyed doing good deeds; Mujiang'a had always valued him highly.
translations.idiomatic: He loved scholars and enjoyed doing good deeds, and Mujiang'a had always valued him highly.

sentences.zh: 後以論洋務不合，乃被黜。

translations.literal: Later, because his views on foreign affairs did not accord, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because his views on foreign affairs did not accord with policy, he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year of Xianfeng, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1852 he died.

sentences.zh: 何汝霖，字雨人，江蘇江寧人。

translations.literal: He Rulin, style name Yuren, was a native of Jiangning in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He Rulin, styled Yuren, came from Jiangning in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授工部七品小京官。

translations.literal: Selected as tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a tribute student, he passed examination and was appointed a seventh-rank clerk in the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 中式道光五年舉人，充軍機章京，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the 5th year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was repeatedly promoted to department director.
translations.idiomatic: In 1825 he passed the provincial examination, served as a Grand Council clerk, and rose to department director.

sentences.zh: 歷內閣侍讀學士、大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: He served as Grand Secretariat reader and as vice president of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Grand Secretariat reader and vice president of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 偕侍郎恩桂按事浙江，查勘南河料垛。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Minister En Gui he investigated affairs in Zhejiang and inspected grain stockpiles on the Southern Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Vice Minister En Gui to investigate affairs in Zhejiang and inspect grain stockpiles on the Southern Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 命在軍機大臣上行走，歷宗人府丞、副都御史。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers, and served as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and vice censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers and held the posts of vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授兵部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: In the 22nd year, he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of War and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In 1842 he was appointed vice minister of War and transferred to Revenue.

sentences.zh: 偕大學士敬徵勘東河工程。

translations.literal: Together with Grand Secretary Jingzheng he inspected the Eastern Grand Canal works.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Grand Secretary Jingzheng to inspect the Eastern Grand Canal works.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，擢兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the 25th year, he was promoted to minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In 1845 he was promoted to minister of War.

sentences.zh: 值太后七旬萬壽，汝霖母丁年九十，五世同堂，賜御書扁額，尋以母憂歸。

translations.literal: When the empress dowager's seventieth birthday was celebrated, Rulin's mother Ding was ninety years old; five generations lived under one roof; an imperial inscription was bestowed; soon after he returned home on account of his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager's seventieth birthday was celebrated, Rulin's mother Ding was ninety years old and five generations lived under one roof. The emperor bestowed an imperial inscription, and soon after Rulin returned home upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 江蘇大水，命在籍襄治賑務。

translations.literal: When Jiangsu suffered great flooding, he was ordered while at home to assist in managing relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangsu suffered severe flooding, he was ordered to assist in relief work while at home.

sentences.zh: 先是，總督陶澍於江寧立豐備倉以備荒，縣令虧挪穀價，大吏許以他款抵。

translations.literal: Earlier, Governor-General Tao Shu had established the Fengbei Granary in Jiangning to prepare for famine; the county magistrate embezzled grain funds, and senior officials permitted offsetting with other funds.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Governor-General Tao Shu had established the Fengbei Granary in Jiangning to prepare for famine. The county magistrate embezzled grain funds, and senior officials permitted offsetting with other funds.

sentences.zh: 汝霖曰：「倉穀以備兇。

translations.literal: Rulin said: "Granary grain is stored to prepare for famine.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin said: "Granary grain is stored to prepare for famine.

sentences.zh: 今荒像如此，汝霖不敢欺朝廷，當各為奏上。」

translations.literal: Now famine is so evident; Rulin dares not deceive the court; each of us should memorialize separately."
translations.idiomatic: Famine is now so evident that I dare not deceive the court. Each of us should memorialize separately."

sentences.zh: 乃以給賑用。

translations.literal: The grain was then used for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The grain was then used for relief.

sentences.zh: 服闋，命以一品頂戴署禮部侍郎，尋署戶部尚書，仍直軍機處，授禮部尚書。

translations.literal: After mourning ended, he was ordered to serve as acting vice minister of Rites with first-rank insignia; soon after served as acting minister of Revenue, still serving in the Grand Council, and was appointed minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning ended, he was ordered to serve as acting vice minister of Rites with first-rank insignia, soon served as acting minister of Revenue while continuing in the Grand Council, and was appointed minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 汝霖久襄樞務，資勞己深，尚書陳孚恩由章京躋大臣，駸用事，厭汝霖居其前。

translations.literal: Rulin had long served in Grand Council affairs and his seniority and merit were deep; Minister Chen Fu'en had risen from clerk to minister, gradually wielded power, and resented Rulin ranking above him.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin had long served in Grand Council affairs and his seniority and merit were deep. Minister Chen Fu'en had risen from clerk to minister, gradually wielded power, and resented Rulin ranking above him.

sentences.zh: 汝霖年逾七十，一日在直，觸火爐幾僕。

translations.literal: Rulin was over seventy; one day while on duty he bumped into the brazier and nearly fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin was over seventy. One day while on duty he bumped into the brazier and nearly fell.

sentences.zh: 孚恩笑曰：「人當避爐，爐豈能避人？」

translations.literal: Fu'en laughed and said: "People should avoid the brazier; can the brazier avoid people?"
translations.idiomatic: Fu'en laughed and said: "People should avoid the brazier—can the brazier avoid people?"

sentences.zh: 汝霖知其諷己，咸豐二年，以足疾乞罷直，許之。

translations.literal: Rulin knew he was being mocked; in the 2nd year of Xianfeng, he requested to leave Grand Council duty due to foot ailment and was granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: Rulin knew he was being mocked. In 1852 he requested to leave Grand Council duty due to a foot ailment and was granted permission.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，諡恪慎，祀鄉賢。

translations.literal: Soon after he died; posthumous name Ke Shen; enshrined in the local temple of worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after. He was given the posthumous name Ke Shen (Respectful and Cautious) and enshrined in the local temple of worthy men.

sentences.zh: 子兆瀛，浙江鹽運使。

translations.literal: His son Zhaoying served as salt transport commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaoying served as salt transport commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 季芝昌，字仙九，江蘇江陰人。

translations.literal: Ji Zhichang, style name Xianjiu, was a native of Jiangyin in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zhichang, styled Xianjiu, came from Jiangyin in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父麟，直隸鉅鹿知縣，居官慈惠。

translations.literal: His father Lin served as magistrate of Julu in Zhili and was benevolent in office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lin served as magistrate of Julu in Zhili and was benevolent in office.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十八年，捕邪教，焚其籍，免株連數千人。

translations.literal: In the 18th year of Jiaqing, he arrested heretical sect members, burned their registers, and spared several thousand from implicated punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1813 he arrested members of a heretical sect, burned their registers, and spared several thousand people from implicated punishment.

sentences.zh: 坐捕匪不力，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: For failing to suppress bandits effectively, he was exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: For failing to suppress bandits effectively, he was exiled to Yili.

sentences.zh: 芝昌年逾四十，成道光十二年一甲三名進士，授編修，散館第一。

translations.literal: Zhichang was over forty when he ranked third among the top three jinshi graduates in the 12th year of Daoguang; was appointed compiler; and ranked first upon leaving the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhichang was over forty when he ranked third among the top three jinshi graduates in 1832. He was appointed compiler and ranked first upon leaving the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 未幾，大考第三，擢侍讀，督山東學政。

translations.literal: Soon after, in the major triennial evaluation he ranked third and was promoted to reader; he served as director of education for Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, ranked third in the triennial academy evaluation, he was promoted to reader and became educational commissioner for Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十九年，大考复第三，擢少詹事，晉詹事，典江西鄉試，督浙江學政。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, in the major triennial evaluation he again ranked third; was promoted to junior tutor; advanced to tutor; presided over the provincial examination in Jiangxi; and served as director of education for Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1839, again ranked third in the triennial academy evaluation, he was promoted to junior tutor, then tutor, presided over the provincial examination in Jiangxi, and became educational commissioner for Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 母憂歸，服闋，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his mother's death; after mourning ended, he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home upon his mother's death, and after mourning ended was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，授禮部侍郎，督安徽學政，調吏部，又調倉場。

translations.literal: In the 23rd year, he was appointed vice minister of Rites, served as director of education for Anhui, was transferred to Personnel, and again transferred to the grain depot.
translations.idiomatic: In 1843 he was appointed vice minister of Rites, served as educational commissioner for Anhui, transferred to Personnel, and then to the grain depot.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，命偕定郡王載銓籌辦長蘆鹽務，清查天津倉庫，疏陳：「蘆鹽積累，各商憚於承運，懸岸至四十餘處。

translations.literal: In the 28th year, he was ordered together with Prince Ding Zaiquan to manage Changlu salt affairs and inspect Tianjin granaries. He memorialized: "Changlu salt has accumulated; merchants fear undertaking transport; suspended salt yards number more than forty.
translations.idiomatic: In 1848 he was ordered, together with Prince Ding Zaiquan, to manage Changlu salt affairs and inspect Tianjin granaries. He memorialized: "Changlu salt has accumulated; merchants fear undertaking transport; suspended salt yards number more than forty.

sentences.zh: 請將河南二十四州縣仿淮南例改票鹽，先課後引。

translations.literal: He requested that twenty-four prefectures and counties in Henan follow the Huainan precedent and adopt ticket salt, collecting tax before issuing transport permits.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that twenty-four prefectures and counties in Henan follow the Huainan precedent and adopt ticket salt, collecting tax before issuing transport permits.

sentences.zh: 直隸二十四州縣限半年招商招販，無商販即責成州縣領運，或由鹽政遴員官運。

translations.literal: Twenty-four prefectures and counties in Zhili were given half a year to recruit merchants for salt sales; if no merchants came forward, prefectures and counties would be held responsible for transport, or the salt commissioner would select officials for government transport.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four prefectures and counties in Zhili were given half a year to recruit merchants for salt sales. If no merchants came forward, prefectures and counties would be held responsible for transport, or the salt commissioner would select officials for government transport.

sentences.zh: 支銷浮費及官役陋規，永遠裁汰。

translations.literal: Extravagant expenses and corrupt customary fees of officials and clerks should be permanently abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Extravagant expenses and corrupt customary fees of officials and clerks should be permanently abolished.

sentences.zh: 每年應完帑利，灘及通綱額引，與正課一律徵收。

translations.literal: Each year treasury profits, beach levies, and general quota transport permits due should be collected uniformly with regular tax.
translations.idiomatic: Each year treasury profits, beach levies, and general quota transport permits due should be collected uniformly with regular tax.

sentences.zh: 其協濟補欠充公等項加價名目，概行革除。

translations.literal: All surcharges under names such as mutual aid, deficit compensation, and confiscation should be entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All surcharges under names such as mutual aid, deficit compensation, and confiscation should be entirely abolished.

sentences.zh: 並於各引鹽加斤免課，每斤准其減價敵私。」

translations.literal: Moreover, for each transport permit salt should have added weight exempt from tax, and each catty should be permitted reduced price to compete with smuggled salt."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, for each transport permit salt should have added weight exempt from tax, and each catty should be sold at a reduced price to compete with smuggled salt."

sentences.zh: 詔依議行。

translations.literal: The imperial decree approved implementation according to the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，偕大學士耆英赴浙江閱兵，並清查倉庫，籌辦鹽務。

translations.literal: In the 29th year, together with Grand Secretary Qiying he went to Zhejiang to review troops, inspect granaries, and manage salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1849 he joined Grand Secretary Qiying in Zhejiang to review troops, inspect granaries, and manage salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 途經東河、南河，查詢節浮費、裁冗員事宜，奏減東河正款二十萬兩，裁泉河通判、歸河通判，南河每年用款以三百萬兩為率，減省五六十萬兩，並揚運通判於江防廳，改為江運同知，裁丹陽縣丞、靈壁主簿、呂梁洪巡檢，從之。

translations.literal: En route through the Eastern and Southern Grand Canals, he inquired into reducing extravagant expenses and cutting redundant posts; memorialized reducing the Eastern Canal regular appropriation by 200,000 taels; abolishing the Quanhe and Guihe assistant prefect posts; setting the Southern Canal annual expenditure at 3,000,000 taels as standard, saving 500,000 to 600,000 taels; transferring the Yangyun assistant prefect to the river defense office as river transport sub-prefect; abolishing the Danyang assistant magistrate, Lingbi registrar, and Lülianghong inspector posts; the proposals were approved.
translations.idiomatic: En route through the Eastern and Southern Grand Canals, he inquired into reducing extravagant expenses and cutting redundant posts. He memorialized reducing the Eastern Canal regular appropriation by 200,000 taels, abolishing the Quanhe and Guihe assistant prefect posts, setting the Southern Canal annual expenditure at 3,000,000 taels as standard and saving 500,000 to 600,000 taels, transferring the Yangyun assistant prefect to the river defense office as river transport sub-prefect, and abolishing the Danyang assistant magistrate, Lingbi registrar, and Lülianghong inspector posts. The proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 耆英病留清江浦，芝昌獨赴浙江，疏陳變通鹽務章程七事：杭、嘉、紹三所引鹽，分別加斤，止令完交正課；

translations.literal: Qiying fell ill and remained at Qingjiangpu; Zhichang went alone to Zhejiang and memorialized seven reforms to salt regulations: for salt under transport permits from the Hang, Jia, and Shao offices, add weight separately and require only regular tax payment.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying fell ill and remained at Qingjiangpu. Zhichang went alone to Zhejiang and memorialized seven reforms to salt regulations: for salt under transport permits from the Hang, Jia, and Shao offices, add weight separately and require only regular tax payment.

sentences.zh: 松所引鹽，酌裁科則；

translations.literal: For salt under transport permits from the Song office, appropriately reduce tax rates.
translations.idiomatic: For salt under transport permits from the Song office, appropriately reduce tax rates.

sentences.zh: 虛懸口岸，選商接辦，並籌款收鹽；

translations.literal: For suspended salt ports, select merchants to take over operations and raise funds to purchase salt.
translations.idiomatic: For suspended salt ports, select merchants to take over operations and raise funds to purchase salt.

sentences.zh: 緝私責成官商，由運司審覈；

translations.literal: Anti-smuggling responsibility falls on officials and merchants, to be reviewed by the transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Anti-smuggling efforts should be assigned to officials and merchants, with review by the transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 緝獲私鹽，分別充賞，及補課作正配銷；

translations.literal: Seized smuggled salt should be rewarded separately, and deficit taxes made up as regular quota sales.
translations.idiomatic: Seized smuggled salt should be rewarded accordingly, and deficit taxes applied as regular quota sales.

sentences.zh: 禁革引地陋規；

translations.literal: Prohibit and abolish corrupt customary fees in transport permit areas.
translations.idiomatic: Corrupt customary fees in transport permit areas should be prohibited and abolished.

sentences.zh: 覈裁巡驗浮費。

translations.literal: Review and cut extravagant expenses for inspection patrols.
translations.idiomatic: Extravagant expenses for inspection patrols should be reviewed and cut.

sentences.zh: 尋查州縣倉庫，統計實虧之數，多至三百九十餘萬，請將虧數最多之員，革職，勒追；

translations.literal: Soon after he inspected prefecture and county granaries and tallied actual deficits, which amounted to more than 3,900,000; he requested that officials with the largest deficits be dismissed and compelled to repay.
translations.idiomatic: He then inspected prefecture and county granaries and tallied actual deficits exceeding 3,900,000 taels. He requested dismissal and compelled repayment from officials with the largest deficits.

sentences.zh: 不足，則由原任上司按成分賠，或由本省各官分成提補；

translations.literal: If insufficient, then former superiors should compensate by proportion of responsibility, or officials throughout the province should contribute shares to make up the deficit.
translations.idiomatic: If recovery proved insufficient, former superiors should compensate proportionally, or officials throughout the province should contribute shares to make up the deficit.

sentences.zh: 其有欠在胥吏者，尤嚴補追，毋任倖免：並從之。

translations.literal: Where debts lay with clerks, recovery should be especially strict and no one permitted to escape: all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Where debts lay with clerks, recovery should be especially strict with no one permitted to escape. All proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 授山西巡撫，未一月，召署吏部侍郎，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Appointed governor-general of Shanxi; before one month had passed, recalled to serve as acting vice minister of Personnel and ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed governor-general of Shanxi, within a month he was recalled to serve as acting vice minister of Personnel and ordered to serve under the Grand Council ministers.

sentences.zh: 尋授戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon after he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was appointed vice minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢左都御史。

translations.literal: In the 30th year, he was promoted to left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1850 he was promoted to left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，出為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Xianfeng, he went out as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1851 he went out as governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 艇匪在浙洋劫掠山東兵船，被剿遁閩洋，遣水師截擊，賊眾畏罪投誠，分別安置。

translations.literal: Boat bandits in Zhejiang waters plundered Shandong military vessels; pursued to Fujian waters; naval forces were sent to intercept; the bandits surrendered in fear of punishment and were separately resettled.
translations.idiomatic: Boat bandits in Zhejiang waters plundered Shandong military vessels and, pursued to Fujian waters, were intercepted by naval forces. The bandits surrendered in fear of punishment and were separately resettled.

sentences.zh: 二年，兼署福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the 2nd year, he concurrently served as acting general of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1852 he concurrently served as acting general of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 疏請停罷捐納舉人、附生之例；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting abolition of the practice of purchasing juren and supplementary student status through donations.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to abolish the practice of purchasing juren and supplementary student status through donations.

sentences.zh: 又奏禁鹽商代銷官運，以杜取巧：並從之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized prohibiting salt merchants from reselling government-transported salt on behalf of officials to prevent exploitation: the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized prohibiting salt merchants from reselling government-transported salt on behalf of officials to prevent exploitation, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾乞休。

translations.literal: Soon after he requested retirement due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 芝昌以文字受宣宗特達之知，嘗曰：「汝為文，行所無事，譬之於射，五矢無一失。」

translations.literal: Zhichang won the Xuanzong Emperor's exceptional favor through his writing. The emperor once said: "When you write, you proceed without obstruction, like shooting—five arrows, not one miss."
translations.idiomatic: Zhichang won the Xuanzong Emperor's exceptional favor through his writing. The emperor once said: "When you write, you proceed without obstruction, like shooting—five arrows, not one miss."

sentences.zh: 及查辦長蘆、兩浙鹽務稱旨，遂驟進膺樞務。

translations.literal: When his inspection of Changlu and Liangzhe salt affairs pleased the emperor, he suddenly advanced to Grand Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His inspection of Changlu and Liangzhe salt affairs pleased the emperor, and he was suddenly elevated to Grand Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 甫數月，宣宗崩，文宗猶欲用之，畀以外任。

translations.literal: After only a few months the Xuanzong Emperor died; the Wenzong Emperor still wished to use him and gave him an outside appointment.
translations.idiomatic: After only a few months the Xuanzong Emperor died. The Wenzong Emperor still wished to use him and gave him an outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 未一歲，謝職歸。

translations.literal: Before one year had passed, he resigned and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year he resigned and returned home.

sentences.zh: 久之，卒於家，未予卹典。

translations.literal: Long afterward he died at home; no posthumous honors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Long afterward he died at home without receiving posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，署閩浙總督文煜奏陳政績，追諡文敏。

translations.literal: In the early Guangxu reign, acting governor-general Wen Yu memorialized his achievements; the posthumous name Wenmin was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Guangxu reign, Acting Governor-General Wen Yu memorialized his achievements, and the posthumous name Wenmin was granted.

sentences.zh: 子念詒，道光三十年進士，官編修。

translations.literal: His son Nianyi, a jinshi of the 30th year of Daoguang, served as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: His son Nianyi, a jinshi of 1850, served as compiler.

sentences.zh: 孫邦楨，同治十二年進士，官至福建布政使。

translations.literal: His grandson Bangzhen, a jinshi of the 12th year of Tongzhi, rose to financial commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Bangzhen, a jinshi of 1873, rose to financial commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 論曰：承平，士大夫平進而致列卿，或以恪謹稱，或以文學顯，固不能盡有所建樹；

translations.literal: The commentary states: In times of peace, scholar-officials who advanced by regular steps to high ministerial rank were sometimes known for diligence and caution, sometimes distinguished for literary talent—yet they could not all achieve notable accomplishments.
translations.idiomatic: In peaceful times, scholar-officials who rose by regular steps to high ministerial rank were sometimes known for diligence and caution, sometimes distinguished for literary talent—yet not all could achieve notable accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 或餘澤延世，子孫復繼簪纓，若白鎔、那清安、升寅諸人是也。

translations.literal: Or their remaining virtue extended through generations, and their descendants continued in official rank, as with Bai Rong, Na Qingan, Sheng Yin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Others left virtue that extended through generations, with descendants continuing in official rank, as with Bai Rong, Na Qingan, Sheng Yin, and the like.

sentences.zh: 季芝昌晚遭殊遇，已值宣宗倦勤之年，暫任兼圻，奉身而退，其見幾知止者耶？

translations.literal: Ji Zhichang encountered exceptional favor late in life, already when the Xuanzong Emperor was weary of governing; he briefly held concurrent provincial command, then withdrew from office—was this one who saw the moment and knew when to stop?
translations.idiomatic: Ji Zhichang encountered exceptional favor late in life, already when the Xuanzong Emperor was weary of governing. He briefly held concurrent provincial command, then withdrew from office—was this one who saw the moment and knew when to stop?
